V4 MULTI-PERSONA EVOLUTION

For each eligible research direction, run N refinement rounds (default N=3).
Every round MUST generate all three complete variants before selecting one:
- Innovator: maximize non-obvious novelty and allow genuine pivots.
- Pragmatist: maximize feasibility, clean controls, and executable validation.
- Critic: maximize scientific insight, falsifiability, and reviewer defensibility.

Evaluate the current seed, produce all three variants, select one based on evidence, and carry it into the next round.
If the mechanism is a dead end, pivot rather than cosmetically rewrite it.
Do not lose GAP-ID, hypothesis, null hypothesis, negative-result value, or evaluation traceability.
Only final track champions enter Phase 10.
